examples.description: Resolve one Altinn 2 code to its Altinn 3 equivalent

description: Discover the Altinn 3 equivalent of an Altinn 2 service or role code. The 19 June 2026 Altinn 2 deprecation deadline has passed, so this serves remediation for any integration still on Altinn 2. Pass { altinn2_code } (alphanumeric, 1–10 chars, e.g. A0208) for a single mapping, or omit it for the entire migration map. Every response carries the deprecation status computed in Europe/Oslo (deprecation_deadline, days_remaining — floored at 0, deadline_passed — now true). Each entry ships a `verified` flag: gate any production migration action on `verified === true`; unverified entries are hints, not instructions. Deterministic static map (DigDir-sourced) — no government system is contacted at call time. Failure modes: NOT_FOUND when a supplied code is not in the map (omit it to list every entry), VALIDATION_FAILED (INVALID_CODE), SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT (needs read:digdir). No sandbox mirror — a sandbox bearer gets SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/altinn-system-users
description_nb: Finn Altinn 3-tilsvarende for en Altinn 2-kode (utfasingsfristen 19. juni 2026 er passert — dette er nå utbedring). Send { altinn2_code } for én kartlegging, eller utelat for hele listen. Baser produksjonsmigreringer på `verified === true`. Deterministisk statisk kartlegging (DigDir-kilde). Krever read:digdir. Ingen sandkasse-speil.

altinn2_code.description: An Altinn 2 service or role code to resolve (alphanumeric, 1–10 chars, e.g. A0208). Omit to get the entire migration map.
